body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A system for monitoring patient movement comprising:a first tracking device configured to be affixed to a table;
a second tracking device configured to be affixed to an anatomical element, the anatomical element having a pose relative to the table;
at least one processor; and
at least one memory storing instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, cause the at least one processor to:
receive a first dataset, the first dataset containing a first image depictinginformation about the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
receive a second dataset, the second dataset containing information abouta second image depicting the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
process each of the first image and the second image using an image processing algorithm to identify the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
determine a first relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed first image and a second relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed second image,
compare the first datasetrelative pose and the second relative posedataset to determine if a relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has changed, and
generate a notification when the relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has changed.
2. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising:
a user interface, and wherein the memory stores additional instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, further cause the at least one processor to:
cause the notification to be displayed on the user interface.
3. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the notification includes instructions for performing one or more verification steps.
4. (Original The system of claim 3, wherein the memory stores additional instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, further cause the at least one processor to:
determine a spatial relationship between a patient and the second tracking device.
5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the one or more verification steps includes at least one of verifying the [[a]] pose of one or more anatomical elements using a navigation probe or redetermining the spatial relationship between the patient and the second tracking device.
6. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the anatomical element is a vertebra.
7. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising:
a navigation system comprising an optical imaging device, the optical imaging device configured to obtain the first dataset and the second dataset.
8. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the second tracking device comprises a plurality of tracking devices.
9. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) A system for monitoring patient movement comprising:
a first tracking device configured to be affixed to a table;
a second tracking device configured to be affixed to a robot, the robot having a pose relative to the table;
at least one processor; and
at least one memory storing instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, cause the at least one processor to:
receive a first dataset, the first dataset containing a first image depicting information about the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
receive a second dataset, the second dataset containing information aboutabout a second image depicting the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
process each of the first image and the second image using an image processing algorithm to identify the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
determine a first relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed first image and a second relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed second image,
compare the first relative posedataset and the second relative posedataset to determine if a relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has moved, and
generate a notification when a relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has moved.
10. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, wherein the second tracking device is integrated with the robot.
11. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, further comprising:a user interface, and wherein the memory stores additional instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, further cause the at least one processor to:
cause the notification to be displayed on the user interface.
12. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, wherein the notification includes instructions for performing one or more verification steps.
13. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, further comprising:a navigation system comprising an optical imaging device, the optical imaging device configured to obtain the first dataset and the second dataset.
14. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 12, wherein the robot is affixed to the patient positioned on the table and the memory stores additional instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, further cause the at least one processor to:register a patient to a preoperative image.
15. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The system of claim 14, wherein the one or more verification steps includes at least one of verifying a pose of one or more anatomical elements using a navigation probe or re-registering the patient to the preoperative image.
16. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, wherein the first dataset and the second dataset comprises image data.
17. (Withdrawn) The system of claim 9, wherein the first dataset and the second dataset comprises sensor data.

21. (New) A system for monitoring patient movement comprising:a first tracking device affixed to a table;
a second tracking device affixed to an anatomical element, the anatomical element having a pose relative to the table;
at least one processor; and
at least one memory storing instructions for execution by the at least one processor that, when executed, cause the at least one processor to:
receive a first dataset, the first dataset containing first sensor data corresponding to the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
receive a second dataset, the second dataset containing second sensor data corresponding to the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
process each of the first sensor data and the second sensor data to identify the first tracking device and the second tracking device,
determine a first relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed first sensor data and a second relative pose of the first tracking device relative to the second tracking device from the processed second sensor data,
compare the first relative pose and the second relative pose to determine if a relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has changed, and
generate a notification when the relative pose of the first tracking device and the second tracking device has changed.
22. (New) The system of claim 21, further comprising at least one sensor that measures sensor data corresponding to the first tracking device and the second tracking device.
23. (New) The system of claim 22, wherein the at least one sensor comprises at least one of an optical camera, an infrared camera, a 3D camera system, or a stereoscopic vision system.
